'''610''' is the [[natural number]] following 609 and preceding 611.

==In mathematics==
610 is a [[deficient number]], a [[Markov number]],<ref>{{cite OEIS|A002559|Markov numbers}}</ref> a [[sphenic number]],<ref>{{cite OEIS|A379372|Sphenic numbers}}</ref> a [[generalized pentagonal number]],<ref>{{cite OEIS|A001318|Generalized pentagonal numbers}}</ref> and the 15th number of the [[Fibonacci sequence]],<ref>{{cite OEIS|A000045|Fibonacci numbers}}</ref> which is also the smallest Fibonacci number that begins with 6.<ref>{{Cite web |title=What's Special About This Number? |url=https://erich-friedman.github.io/numbers.html |access-date=2026-07-14 |website=erich-friedman.github.io}}</ref>
